description: This file contains functions related to merging accounts with templates within the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for selecting accounts, toggling UI elements, and handling merge actions.

methods.name: massMerge(module)
methods.description: Handles merging a list of accounts with a selected template by collecting selected account IDs and redirecting to the merge action.

methods.name: mergeshowhide(argg)
methods.description: Shows or hides a UI element based on its current display state.

methods.name: mergehide(argg)
methods.description: Hides a UI element by setting its display to 'none'.

methods.name: moveMe(arg1)
methods.description: Calculates the mouse position for drag operations, potentially used for moving UI components.
